verdict: ROAS holds strong at 5.28x, but purchase volume needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns turned $1,485.72 in spend into $7,838.50 in revenue — a 5.28x return — across 39 purchases. In the most recent 7 days, purchase volume dropped 27.27%, likely tied to a roughly 10% pullback in daily spend that narrowed delivery and reach; however, average order value lifted enough that ROAS actually ticked up 1.21% in the same window, so efficiency held. Google Business Profile actions fell sharply over the last 3 days, which is being monitored closely to determine whether it reflects a platform fluctuation or a visibility gap requiring action. Several project deliverables — including the subscribe-page funnel test and platform ownership audit — are past their target dates and are being escalated to clear before the end of September. Next period, you should expect tighter attribution visibility as the funnel tracking is resolved, and the subscribe pages are on track to go live by September 30.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions dropped to near zero over the last 3 days, from 27–30 actions per day earlier in the month — organic local visibility has gone quiet.
watch_item.fix: We are actively investigating the cause and will confirm whether this is a platform fluctuation or a listing issue requiring correction within this week.
